title: Phase 7 Codex Prompt Handoff
description: Validates a normalized non-executing prompt handoff to Codex. This schema validates prompt context only; it does not execute Codex actions, call providers, mutate runtime state, trigger deployments or bypass human approval.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this Codex prompt handoff schema contract.

promptId.description: Deterministic, id-safe identifier for this prompt handoff.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp for when the prompt handoff was created.

userObjective.description: Concise objective the prompt handoff is meant to preserve for review.

repoContext.description: Repository context required for the prompt handoff without embedding secrets or local machine-specific paths.

branch.description: Expected Git branch for the work.

relevantPaths.description: Repository-relative paths relevant to the handoff.

knownUntrackedFiles.description: Known untracked repository-relative files that must remain out of scope.

phaseConstraints.description: Phase-specific scope boundaries for the prompt handoff.

phase.description: Studio OS phase identifier for the handoff.

allowedScope.description: Allowed work boundaries for the handoff.

nonGoals.description: Explicit non-goals that the handoff must not perform.

safetyBoundaries.description: Explicit safety boundaries that constrain the prompt handoff.

noProviderCalls.description: Whether provider calls are forbidden by this handoff.

noDeployments.description: Whether deployments are forbidden by this handoff.

noRuntimeMutation.description: Whether runtime mutation is forbidden by this handoff.

noSecretExposure.description: Whether secret or token exposure is forbidden by this handoff.

noUnapprovedPush.description: Whether Git push without explicit human approval is forbidden by this handoff.

allowedActions.description: Explicit actions allowed within the non-executing prompt handoff boundary.

forbiddenActions.description: Explicit actions forbidden by the prompt handoff, including provider calls, runtime mutation, deployments and unapproved pushes where relevant.

expectedResponseShape.description: Expected response sections for the Codex handoff.

summary.description: Whether the response must include a concise summary.

filesChanged.description: Whether the response must list changed files.

checksRun.description: Whether the response must report checks run or explicitly skipped.

risks.description: Whether the response must identify residual risks.

verdict.description: Whether the response must include a final go, hold or stop verdict.

approvalRequirements.description: Human approval requirements for the prompt handoff.

requiresHumanApproval.description: Whether explicit human approval is required before downstream action.

approvalReason.description: Reason human approval is required, when applicable.

blockedWithoutApproval.description: Whether the handoff must remain blocked until approval is granted.

nonExecutableMetadata.description: Review and traceability metadata only. This object must not contain executable instructions, provider credentials, secrets, tokens, deployment actions or local machine paths.
